title: Generate Gerber files through an Output Job
summary: Attaches a template Output Job to the focused project, opens it as IWSM_OutputJobDocument and runs only its Gerber outputer into a chosen folder with IOutputer.DM_Generate_OutputFilesTo, with no user interface and full cleanup.
phrasings: export Gerbers from a PCB without dialogs
run one output of an OutJob from code
generate fabrication files to a folder
add a temporary document to a project

commands.name: GenerateGerber
commands.description: Generate Gerber files for the active PcbDoc through a temporary Output Job attached to the focused project; returns the outputers, the DM_Generate_OutputFilesTo result, whether the temp job was detached, and the files written under Out
commands.params: Out=<folder> (default <temp>\GenerateGerber)|OutJob=<.OutJob template> (default: the Gerber.OutJob embedded in the Impl assembly)
